name: niisin
ingredients_raw: NOODLES (80.00%): Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Edible Vegetable Oil (Palm Oil), Tapioca Starch, lodised Sait, Acidity Regulators [INS 451(i) & INS 500(i)], Turmeric Powder, Thickener (INS 412) & Antioxidant (INS 319). SEASONING MIX (12.50%): Sugar, Hydrolysed Vegetable Protein Powder (Soya), Soya Sauce Powder, Garlic Powder, lodised Salt, Mixed Spices 4.5% (Red Chilli, Ginger, Cumin, Black Pepper, Turmeric & Coriander), Acidity Regulators (INS 330 & INS 260), Onion Powder, Flavour Enhancers (INS 631&INS 627), Natural Flavour, Red Chilli Flakes, Dehydrated Spring Onion, Tomato Powder, Oleoresin Capsicum & Anticaking Agent (INS 551) SEASONING OIL (7.50%): Edible Vegetable Oil (Palmolein, Soya Bean Oil & Chilli Seed Oil), Colour [INS 160c(i)] & Oleoresin Rosemary ALLERGEN INFORMATION: CONTAINS WHEAT & SOY. MAY CONTAIN MILK.
